evidence: Modifies core cryptographic primitives in src/crypto/ with a vectorized ChaCha20 implementation.
rationale: Implements a 2x-3x throughput speedup for ChaCha20 to address CPU bottlenecks where encryption takes up to 30% of the network thread during BIP324 v2 transport. This delivers significant performance gains to node-wide crypto primitives on supported x86-64 and ARM64 platforms.
